text: Do any SCADA, DCS, or field records show a simultaneous low-pressure event at other downstream points (e.g., North gallery) that would indicate an upstream source failure versus a localized leak?
What was the recorded value or state of local indication P-R at 09:45 AM and immediately before the pressure loss?
Did the Utilities team acknowledge receipt of the air-low alarm before or after pressure was restored? If yes, how long did it take?
What specific equipment or process condition caused the air-low indication to appear at RHOB P-R at approximately 10:00 AM?
